About This Role

Job Title: Director, Engineering - Transmission Line

At QISG, our Transmission Line teams play a vital role in the safe, reliable, and efficient delivery of power across communities and regions. We design, build, maintain, and upgrade high-voltage transmission infrastructure that supports the backbone of the electric grid. Whether working on new construction, line upgrades, or critical maintenance, our teams ensure projects are executed with the highest standards of safety, quality, and performance. Our work involves both traditional methods and the latest industry innovations to deliver sustainable, cost-effective, and reliable solutions for our customers.

The Director of Engineering for Transmission is a senior leadership role responsible for overseeing the planning, design, and implementation of transmission line projects. This role involves managing a team of engineers and technical staff, ensuring that projects meet regulatory, safety, and quality standards, and supporting the company's strategic objectives. The Director will collaborate with other departments, stakeholders, and external partners to drive innovation, efficiency, and operational excellence in the company's transmission engineering activities.

Develop project budgets, schedules, and resource plans, and ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget.
Manage risks and resolve issues that may impact project scope, quality, and delivery.
Provide technical guidance and expertise in the design and optimization of transmission and substation systems.
Stay current with industry trends, technologies, and regulatory changes, and integrate best practices into the engineering processes.

Identify and evaluate new business opportunities, partnerships, and technologies that can enhance the company's competitive position.
Collaborate with other departments, such as Operations, Finance, and Regulatory Affairs, to align engineering initiatives with broader business goals.

added.description:
Director, Network Engineering & Operations

Direct Hire

Remote + Up to 25% Travel (Domestic and International. Active US Passport is required)

Position Summary

The Director, Network Engineering & Operations leads the implementation, support, and continuous improvement of secure enterprise network services across multiple countries. The role is accountable for reliable connectivity among offices, remote users, cloud platforms, data centers, on-premises environments, and third-party services while ensuring that network designs and operating practices comply with applicable regulatory, data-residency, privacy, cybersecurity, and telecommunications requirements.

The Director leads network engineers, service partners, carriers, and vendors and works closely with Cybersecurity, Cloud, Infrastructure, Architecture, Service Management, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Facilities, Procurement, and business leadership. The role combines strong technical expertise with operational discipline, documentation, stakeholder communication, and the ability to support a globally distributed environment. This is a remote position; some domestic and international travel will be required for site assessments, implementations, migrations, major incidents, and strategic planning.

Top Responsibilities

Architecture of all physical, virtual datacenters, and office networks
Required Expertise: Fortinet, Azure, Palo Alto, Enterprise Identity, Zscaler, Wireless, Circuits (DIA, Broadband)
ITSM/ITOM systems interconnection (Halo, NetBox, FortiManager/Analyzer/Authenticator/EMS)
Office/Workplace networking and circuits, VLAN design, Secure Access Design/Implementation
Operations / support design

Network Architecture, Design and Implementation

Plan and execute Network integration and migration to cloud
Architect of global network implementation, roadmap, engineering standards, and operational maintenance of Office cloud and on-premises environments.
Stand up full Fortinet Estate to service existing and new Datacenter, Cloud, and Office networks
Cloud Micro segmentation
Cloud NVA standup, design, maintenance, routing
Network DR design, execution, and demonstration

Network Team Leadership

Lead the design and implementation of secure, resilient networks that connect offices, cloud platforms, data centers, on-premises systems, remote users, and business partners across multiple countries.
Translate business growth, geographic expansion, application, security, resilience, and user-experience requirements into scalable network plans.
Provide technical and operational leadership for local-area, wide-area, wireless, internet, remote-access, cloud-connectivity, and network-security services.
Establish governance, service ownership, decision rights, performance expectations, escalation paths, and lifecycle standards.
Advise senior leadership on network architecture, regulatory considerations, operational risks, costs, dependencies, and modernization priorities.
Develop reference architectures and engineering standards for routing, switching, wireless, firewalls, segmentation, SD-WAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP, load balancing, and internet connectivity.
Design hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity patterns that support Azure, other cloud services, private infrastructure, offices, remote users, and third-party providers while maintaining performance, security, availability, and cost discipline.
Lead technical discovery, site assessments, capacity planning, implementation planning, testing, cutover, rollback, stabilization, and operational handoff.
Architect with the goal of utilizing Microservices / Containerization wherever possible (i.e. Azure Kubernetes Services)

Network Security and Regulatory Compliance

Partner with Cybersecurity, Legal, Compliance, and Privacy teams to identify and address country-specific regulatory, data-residency, privacy, encryption, monitoring, cross-border connectivity, and telecommunications requirements.
Ensure network architecture and operations comply with enterprise security standards, regulatory obligations, contractual commitments, and audit requirements.

Architectural Platforms and Network Engineering

Own Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco, Zscaler, and Cisco Meraki technology portfolios across enterprise networking and security use cases.
Build Cloud NVA architecture in Azure, AWS, etc. and design for integration of on-premises assets with an eventual goal of moving to an all-cloud footing
Establish boilerplate hardened configurations, templates, firmware standards, lifecycle plans, testing requirements, and secure deployment patterns, using automation wherever practical.
Guide implementation and operation of secure access service edge and zero-trust network access capabilities, with preference for Zscaler (think SASE and Network ID-gated transit).
Drive platform rationalization and interoperability while avoiding unnecessary complexity, duplicated capabilities, unsupported configurations, and vendor lock-in.
Ensure network tools integrate effectively with identity, endpoint, cloud, security operations, monitoring, configuration-management, and service-management platforms.
Design and implement NetBox as the network source of truth, including network CMDB capabilities, parameter documentation, reporting, and API-based integrations with ITSM and ITOM platforms.

Network Operations and Service Reliability

Lead day-to-day network operations, event monitoring, incident response, problem management, change management, capacity management, and service restoration.
Establish, engineer, and own NMS system(s) (i.e. PRTG)
Establish service-level objectives, availability targets, operational metrics, on-call expectations, escalation procedures, and major-incident communication practices

Cloud and On-Premises Connectivity

Partner with Cloud and Infrastructure teams on routing, private connectivity, cloud firewalls, virtual networks, network security groups, DNS, traffic inspection, hybrid service dependencies, and complex connectivity troubleshooting.
Troubleshoot performance and connectivity issues that span applications, identity, security controls, carriers, cloud platforms, and physical networks.

Documentation, Governance and Communication

Create and maintain accurate network diagrams, standards, inventories, IP address plans, data flows, firewall documentation, runbooks, operating procedures, support models, and recovery plans.
Ensure implementation plans include scope, dependencies, risks, testing, approvals, communications, cutover procedures, rollback steps, validation criteria, and operational acceptance.

Vendor, Carrier and Financial Management

Contribute to vendor evaluation, product selection, contract support, renewals, service reviews, escalation, and performance management.
Identify cost and service improvements through carrier optimization, platform consolidation, contract negotiation, automation, and demand management.

Team Leadership

Lead, develop, and mentor network engineers, technical leads, contractors, and service partners supporting a global environment.
Define responsibilities, priorities, performance objectives, engineering practices, on-call coverage, and delivery expectations.
Manage workload, capacity, recruitment, performance, cross-training, succession planning, and professional development.
Promote accountability, technical excellence, disciplined change, proactive risk management, strong documentation, and continuous improvement.
Build effective working relationships across cultures, regions, time zones, technical teams, and business functions.

Required Qualifications

5 or more years of progressive network engineering and operations experience, including at least 2 years in technical leadership or people management roles.
Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise networks across multiple countries and time zones.
Deep expertise with the Fortinet portfolio, including FortiGate, FortiGate NVA, FortiSwitch, FortiAP, FortiLink, Fortinet SD-WAN, FortiClient EMS, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, and FortiAuthenticator.
Experience with NetBox, including API-based integrations and use of relevant plugin libraries.
Experience using Semaphore, Terraform, or similar tools for network automation and infrastructure as code.
Experience with Zscaler or Palo Alto Prisma Access, including secure access service edge or zero-trust network access capabilities.
Deep expertise with Azure networking and hybrid cloud connectivity, including private connectivity, virtual networks, cloud firewalls, routing, and traffic inspection.
Experience in a regulated, audit-intensive, financial services, insurance, or multinational organization.
Intimate knowledge of routing, switching, wireless, firewalls, segmentation, SD-WAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP, internet connectivity, monitoring, and network troubleshooting

Preferred Qualifications

Relevant Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, cloud, security, or ITIL certifications.
Fortinet NSE5 or greater preferred
Cisco CCNA or greater preferred
Microsoft, Palo Alto certifications a plus
Experience with network automation, infrastructure as code, configuration management, observability, and API-based operational tooling.
Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, international expansion, office openings, relocations, or consolidations.
Experience managing telecommunications carriers, managed network services, enterprise licensing, contracts, and global vendors.

Translate client requirements into system design and develop solutions that deliver measurable business value.
Lead, design, develop and deliver large-scale data systems, data processing, data transformation, and data platform modernization initiatives.

Support AI-enabled engineering use cases by designing high-quality data foundations, retrieval patterns, context engineering approaches, and scalable data services that power agentic and machine learning solutions.
Automate data platform operations and manage post-production systems, observability, quality, reliability, and operational processes, including telemetry pipelines that capture prompt, response, trace, latency, token, and cost data for AI-enabled services in a queryable form.
Conduct technical feasibility assessments and provide project estimates for the design and development of solutions.
Mentor, support, and grow junior team members while contributing hands-on to delivery.

Demonstrable experience implementing end-to-end data pipelines and production-grade data platforms.
Hands-on experience with at least one leading public cloud data platform: Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform;
Experience with Databricks as a data engineering platform is strongly preferred, including working with notebooks, jobs, Delta Lake, or similar lakehouse patterns.
Strong Python proficiency and practical experience using Python-based tooling for data engineering, automation, platform development, or AI engineering workflows.
Implementation experience with column-oriented database technologies such as BigQuery, Redshift, Vertica, or similar platforms; NoSQL database technologies such as DynamoDB, Bigtable, Cosmos DB, or similar; and traditional database systems such as SQL Server, Oracle, or MySQL.
Experience implementing data pipelines for both streaming and batch integrations using tools and frameworks such as Glue ETL, Lambda, Google Cloud Dataflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, Spark Streaming, or similar technologies.
Experience with data modeling, warehouse design, fact/dimension implementations, and modern lakehouse or data mesh patterns.
Experience with code repositories, continuous integration, automated testing, release management, and production support practices.
Familiarity with MLOps concepts and the data engineering responsibilities required to support AI/ML deployment, validation, monitoring, rollback, and operational reliability.
Ability to handle module or track-level responsibilities while contributing to tasks hands-on.
Good communication skills and willingness to work as part of a collaborative, cross-functional team.

AI Engineering & Modern Data Platform Experience:

Exposure to AI engineering patterns, including context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation support patterns, agent architectures, and production data services that support AI-enabled experiences.
Experience building and maintaining the pipelines behind retrieval systems, including document parsing, chunking, metadata extraction, embedding generation, and incremental reindexing, alongside the vector databases, graph databases, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval structures they feed.
Exposure to agentic platforms or cloud AI services such as Vertex AI, Azure AI services, AWS AI services, or comparable platforms; specific platform experience is less important than understanding how AI engineering differs from traditional data engineering.
Practical experience deploying agents, integrating agent frameworks, or supporting agentic workflows in production or near-production environments is a plus.
Experience building evaluation data infrastructure for AI systems, including ground-truth and golden datasets, offline evaluation pipelines, and the data scaffolding behind LLM-as-judge and regression testing.
Experience modeling and persisting agent state, including session context, conversation history, and memory stores, treating them as a durable storage and data modeling problem rather than an application detail.
Support AI-enabled engineering use cases by designing high-quality data foundations, retrieval patterns, context engineering approaches, and scalable data services that power agentic and machine learning solutions, applying the same lineage, provenance, and data contract rigor to context and retrieval sources that you would to a production warehouse.
Experience with agentic harnesses or orchestration tools such as Pi, Hermes Agent, or similar platforms is a plus, but not required.
Experience with Snowflake and zero-copy architecture patterns is a plus, particularly for retail, financial services, energy, or CPG-oriented use cases.

Set Yourself Apart With:

Developer certifications for AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, or related cloud/data platforms.
Demonstrated experience applying AI engineering concepts in practical business environments rather than only academic or research settings.
Hands-on experience supporting AI/ML and LLM lifecycle needs such as model deployment support, monitoring, validation, shadow deployments, release management, and evaluation or data quality measurement for both predictive models and generative systems.
Experience in retail, financial services, energy, CPG, logistics, manufacturing, or other data-rich industries where applied AI and large-scale data engineering are used to solve operational or client-facing problems.
Understanding of Agile, product, and delivery methodologies in consulting or client-facing environments.
